🎥 @monsternorm 
📸 @chiefmartinez 

OhGeesy, Born Alejandro Carranza, Is A Mexican-American Rapper From Los Angeles, California, Best Known As One Of The Founding Members Of The West Coast Rap Group Shoreline Mafia. The Group Rose To Fame With Hits Like “Musty,” “Nun Major,” And “Bands,” Helping Bring A New Wave Of Los Angeles Street Rap Into The Mainstream.

Following Shoreline Mafia’s Initial Run, OhGeesy Launched A Successful Solo Career, Releasing Projects Like Geezyworld And Collaborating With Artists Including DaBaby, YG, And Other Major Names In Hip-Hop. Known For His Distinctive Flow, Catchy Hooks, And West Coast Sound, OhGeesy Has Become One Of The Most Recognizable Figures In LA’s Modern Rap Scene.

Jamie Foxx, Born Eric Marlon Bishop, Is An American Actor, Comedian, Singer, And Entertainer From Terrell, Texas. He First Gained Recognition Through His Comedy Performances On In Living Color Before Becoming A Household Name With The Jamie Foxx Show. He Later Established Himself As One Of Hollywood’s Most Versatile Entertainers.

Foxx Won An Academy Award For His Portrayal Of Ray Charles In The 2004 Film Ray And Has Starred In Major Movies Including Django Unchained, Collateral, And Baby Driver. Beyond Acting, He Has Enjoyed A Successful Music Career, Collaborating With Artists Like Kanye West, T-Pain, And Drake. His Contributions To Film, Comedy, And Music Have Made Him One Of The Most Accomplished Multi-Talented Entertainers Of His Generation.

OhGeesy Also Released Paid N Full In 2025 And Continued His Work With Shoreline Mafia Following The Group’s Reunion.

Jamie Foxx Is Also A Grammy Award-Winning Musician, Known For Songs Like “Blame It” And His Contributions To Kanye West’s “Gold Digger.” Hollywood Walk of Fame +1
